evidence.quote: Generally, businesses and household finances are in solid shape.
One, significantly heightened uncertainty, two, an increased risk of a slowdown in economic activity, and three, prospects for higher inflation.
Treasury markets also continued to function in an orderly fashion throughout the episode.

More generally, a sufficiently large income shock could strain the debt-servicing capacity of a broader group of households and push up delinquency and default rates, resulting in more substantial losses for lenders.

parsed.rationale: The speech centers on macro-finance research and the financial stability assessment, and it offers no view on the path of monetary policy. It notes tariff-related slowdown and inflation risks and some household stress, but overall finds the financial system resilient, so the net signal is near neutral.
